title: Family RPG
description: Role play as a eighteen year old highschool senior, living with a preset family of your choice.
prompt: Choose who raised you. Your character will be 18 years old and still in highschool, living with a preset family of your choice.

options.title: Step Dad
options.prompt:
You are ${Your name} an eighteen-year-old highschool senior who lives with ${His, Her, Their} Mother, stepfather, and younger step brother.
You are sitting on your bed scrolling through your phone when you hear your stepfather call for you to come downstairs. You slide off your bed and walk to the door. You open your door and walk downstairs and into the kitchen.

options.title: Step Mom
options.prompt:
Your name is %{Your name} you are an eighteen year old highschool senior who lives with ${His, her, or their} step mother, father, and older stepsister. 

You are currently sitting on your bed scrolling through your phone when you hear a soft knock on your door. “Come in” You call out.

options.title: Bio Parents
options.prompt:
Your name is ${Your name} you are an eighteen year old highschool senior who lives with ${His, her, or their} mom and dad. Your parents are ${are you parents nice, cruel, mean, sweet, etc.}. Which has influenced your life and your personality. You currently work with your parents part time. Your parents own a small shop that focuses on selling different instruments and other music related things.

You hear your alarm go off and groan as you stir in your bed. It’s the weekend but you have to go to work with you parents to help out. You slide out of bed and head to your closet. You put on a ${Your outfit} and head downstairs to eat breakfast. You open your bedroom door and walk downstairs.

options.title: Aunt and Uncle
options.prompt:
You are ${Your name} an eighteen year old who lives with ${His, her, their} uncle and his wife. Your parents passed away when you were really young and you have spent about a decade with living with your aunt and uncle. 

You are relaxing in bed when you start to feel peckish and decide to head downstairs to find some snacks. You enter the kitchen and see your aunt cooking dinner.

options.title: Older Sister
options.prompt:
You are ${Your name} an eighteen year old who lives with ${His, her, their} older sister. Your older sister  has been taking care of you since you were very young. 

You are sitting on your bed, scrolling through your phone when you hear a knock on the door. It can only be one person, your older sibling. “Come in” You call out.

cardPool.title: Mia
cardPool.value: Mia is your mother. She is a thirty six year old woman with long black hair and blue eyes. She is a seamstress. She likes to design and style clothes. She is stern and not very affectionate but still loves you dearly, even though she does not show it.

cardPool.title: Arron
cardPool.value: Arron is your stepfather a handsome man with long blond hair and green eyes. He is kind and sensitive. He works as a preschool teacher. He adores children. He spoils you because he thinks you don’t get enough attention. He is charismatic and caring. He is the opposite of your mother.

cardPool.title: Hue
cardPool.value: Hue is your younger stepbrother who has short curly blond hair and green eyes. He is adorable and follows you around. He is cheerful and energetic. He likes sports and video gaming.

cardPool.title: Sora
cardPool.value: Sora is your older step sister who is 20 years old and attends college. She is very pretty and athletic. She got a scholarship for her outstanding athletic abilities. She catching everyone’s eye because of her stunning looks. She adores you and loves to spoil you.  She loves sweets and drags you to sweet shops.

cardPool.title: Daniel
cardPool.value: Daniel is your father. He adores you and spoils you rotten. He is a successful businessman and met your stepmother about ten years ago and got married right away. He is 54 years old. He has short black hair and blue eyes. He is a kind and naive man.

cardPool.title: Laila
cardPool.value: Laila is your stepmother. She is a beautiful middle aged woman with long brown hair she normally wears in a bun. She is an amazing housewife and spends a lot of time cooking and cleaning. Her food isn’t the best but she always puts a lot of love and effort into it. She loves to paint when she doesn’t have household tasks to do. You have known her since you were 8 years old.

cardPool.title: Jason
cardPool.value: Jason is your uncle. He took you in after your parents passed away. He acts cold and emotionless but he actually cares deeply for you. He has messy black hair and green eyes. He works as a CEO.

cardPool.title: Daria
cardPool.value: Daria is your aunt, she married your uncle. You aren’t related but she treats you like her own kid. She is a stay at home mom basically. She is cheerful and caring woman with medium length brown hair and grayish eyes.

cardPool.title: Eden
cardPool.value: Eden is your older sister who has taken care of you for many years now in place of your parents. She is strict and mother like. She scolds you all the time but truthfully she adores you and wants the best for you.

cardPool.title: Everest
cardPool.value: Everest is your older brother who has taken care of you for many years now. He is stern and scolding. He babies you. He thinks of you as a little kid even though you are 18. He scolds you all the time but truthfully he adores you and wants the best for you.
